notes.title: Latest from New Reality Games, State of Anarchy: Master of Mayhem
notes.content:
The sequel to State of Anarchy is here! 
we've reached the day of release and now the time to annihilate aliens is nigh, Huzzah!
Pick up State of Anarchy: Master of Mayhem now whilst it's on discount by clicking on the link below and please leave a review if you have the time!
If you have any constructive criticism or problems, please let us know so we can work on addressing them at once!
Happy shooting,
--Oliver

http://store.steampowered.com/app/576130/

notes.title: Latest From Exagon Games, W.O.R.B.I.T.S!
notes.content:
Exagon games are creating a new, artistic and psychedelic FPS that  FPS will just love! With interesting mechanics and psychedelic maps, you'll spend hours playing this great game! 
But first we need your help to get it through Steam Greenlight!  If you're interested, click on the link below to check it out and if you want to play it, then click the thumbs up button to help this game become a reality! 
If you have any feedback/constructive criticism for the developers, please comment on the Greenlight page and we'll pass it on, to help this game grow to bigger and better things!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=874820157
